The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration proposed new regulations requiring cyan exterior lighting on driverless vehicles to improve visibility and standardize visual identification [1](https://www.notateslaapp.com/news/4892/nhtsa-proposes-cyan-lights-for-driverless-cars-like-cybercab)[2](https://electrek.co/2026/10/24/nhtsa-proposes-cyan-lights-for-robotaxis-following-mercedes-china/). Amazon’s Zoox unit issued a software recall for its entire fleet of 270 driverless vehicles following a crash in Las Vegas [3](https://www.wionews.com/autonews/zoox-recalls-robotaxis-after-self-driving-crash-in-las-vegas-9043732). The Air Force successfully conducted a flight test in which an F-22 pilot controlled the unmanned YFQ-44 aircraft, demonstrating progress in manned-unmanned teaming capabilities [4](https://www.aero-news.net/index.cfm?do=main.textpost&id=7627FA03-CC92-4B79-B30A-DCC323A1726A).

The Federal Aviation Administration cleared Beta Technologies' Alia eVTOL aircraft for passenger demonstration flights, supporting the company's certification process under the Advanced Air Mobility Integration Pilot Program [5](https://www.ainonline.com/futureflight). The agency also granted approval for BETA to conduct market surveys for its A250 eVTOL aircraft [6](https://www.ch-aviation.com/news/173167-uss-beta-receives-faa-approval-for-a250-market-surveys). Archer Aviation announced the launch of air taxi networks in Houston, Dallas, and Austin, expanding its eVTOL operations in Texas [7](https://aviationworld.in/archer-unveils-texas-air-taxi-networks-across-houston-dallas-and-austin/). Waymo expanded its robotaxi service to include pickups at the Las Vegas airport [8](https://www.motorbiscuit.com/waymo-robotaxis-now-pick-up-at-the-las-vegas-airport-but-not-everyone-can-ride-yet/)[9](https://cedarnews.net/newstasks/1091617/us-waymo-launches-services-harry-reid-international/).

Siemens Mobility was awarded a $772 million contract to supply trainsets for the California High-Speed Rail project [10](https://metrorailtoday.com/news/siemens-mobility-awarded-772-million-trainset-contract-for-california-high-speed-rail-project). Duffy announced a $200 million investment to expand truck parking facilities in 12 states [11](https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/newsroom/press-releases). Boom Supersonic announced a $150 million expansion of its Centennial factory, expected to create up to 500 jobs and support manufacturing for its Overture civil supersonic aircraft [12](https://avi-go.com/news/articles/5afebe98839c61e4c1d7a6d05161e8dd).

NATO deployed additional counter-drone protection systems at its Brussels headquarters, combining radar, optical cameras, and radio-frequency detection systems [13](https://www.dronewatch.eu/nato-deploys-additional-counter-drone-protection-at-brussels-headquarters/). The Department of Homeland Security Science and Technology Directorate conducted field tests with first responders to assess four commercially available counter-unmanned-aircraft-system sensors [14](https://shattered.io/counter-drone-technology-first-responders-dhs-nustl-saver-2026/). Elon Musk accused Ukraine of breaching Starlink usage rules amid intensified Russian drone attacks [15](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-oleshky-melania-trump-ceasefire-starlink-b3072649.html).
